name: jansson
input_api: json_loadb(const char *buffer, size_t buflen, size_t flags, json_error_t *error)
documentation_note: Read the Docs serves no per-release path for 2.15.1; 'latest' rendered 'Jansson 2.15.1 documentation' on 2026-11-17. The pinned tarball's doc/apiref.rst documents json_loadb (line 1383) and json_object_seed (line 920).
scope: RFC 8259 JSON text (object or array root, flags 0) decoded into a json_t tree
family_note: Own lexer and recursive-descent parser in src/load.c with UTF-8 checks in src/utf.c and number conversion via strtod in src/strconv.c. No external JSON library. The harness fixes json_object_seed(1) so object hash layout repeats.
